threshold_rationale.selected_measure: U.S. motor vehicle traffic fatality rate per 100 million vehicle miles traveled
threshold_rationale.rationale: A transportation lower-cost scenario should not be treated as admissible if reviewed policy and stress evidence raise the nationwide roadway fatality rate above the latest completed-year FARS Annual Report File baseline. The rate, rather than the fatality count alone, controls for changes in vehicle miles traveled.
threshold_rationale.source_table: NHTSA DOT HS 813 800 Table 1, 2024 FARS ARF full-year fatality rate

baseline_values.reporting_period: calendar year 2024 FARS Annual Report File

primary_baseline.measure: U.S. motor vehicle traffic fatality rate

supporting_context.measure: 2025 projected motor vehicle traffic fatality rate

source_custody.publisher: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, National Center for Statistics and Analysis
